name: system-design-architect
description: Visual-first, model-driven systems design for ChatGPT and Codex. Builds, reviews, explains, operates, and evolves systems end to end with granular BUILD READY process specifications.

interface.shortDescription: Design and build systems visually, end to end
interface.longDescription: A visual-first systems architect that turns ideas and existing systems into canonical models, synchronized views, granular implementation steps, controls, recovery loops, and governed evolution.
defaultPrompt: Use System Design Architect to build this system end to end and show it visually.
Review this existing system, reconstruct AS-IS first, then produce TARGET and BUILD READY implementation steps.
Use System Health mode to diagnose drift and design bounded recovery and adaptation.
